This is a mandatory requirement for our department's 9M26 compliance.
Let me know if you face any technical issues with the system.
traps: 说成 'Why haven't you done the training?'：带有指责意味，会破坏团队关系。应直接说出要求。
说成 'It is boring but just finish it'：不要带入个人情绪评价合规工作。应强调 'mandatory requirement'。
说成 'Do it now'：过于生硬，显得缺乏职场礼仪。应用 'Please ensure... by the end of today'。
wk_cul_compliance_training_followup.ai: Alex，组员。他工作很忙，忘了这件事，被提醒后会立刻去做。
wk_cul_compliance_training_followup.task: 在不影响士气的情况下，要求其在今天下班前完成。

tgt: I see your point about local practices, but strictly speaking, this falls outside our global T&E policy.
To ensure our FY25 books stay clean for the upcoming audit, we need to reclassify this expense.
Let's look at how we can handle this properly without raising flags for the compliance team.
traps: 用了 'You violated the company rule'，显得过于严厉和指责，地道说法应用 'falls outside our global T&E policy'。
用了 'You must change this right now'，语气生硬像在下命令，地道说法应用 'we need to reclassify this expense'。
用了 'Your action is wrong'，词汇选择带有强烈主观审判色彩，地道说法应用 'this needs a bit of adjustment regarding compliance'。
wk_cul_audit_tone.ai: Alex 是该国业务负责人 David。他态度坦然，认为这在当地行业属于潜规则和常规应酬开销，并不觉得自己有违规意图。
wk_cul_audit_tone.task: 在维持专业关系的前提下，明确指出该开销不合规并要求调账

tgt: Transferring the proprietary technology well below its carrying amount to a related entity requires robust justification of the transfer price.
Can you share the internal calculation or business rationale behind setting the consideration at one million HKD?
Since this is a transaction between entities under common control, we need to evaluate its potential impact on the group's financial disclosures.
traps: 使用 'The price is too low, I cannot accept it'，'I cannot accept it' 听起来过于主观个人化，地道说法应用 'requires robust justification of the transfer price'。
使用 'Why you sell it so cheap'，语法错误且带有质问语气（Why you sell 缺少助动词），地道说法应用 'behind setting the consideration at one million HKD'。
使用 'This is controlled by same boss'，表达不够专业，应使用 'between entities under common control'。
aud_rp_trademark_transfer_under_valuatio.ai: Alex是公司战略发展总监。他认为该技术在集团内部调配很正常，且离岸公司后续还要投入大量资金二次开发，所以转让价低是合理的。
aud_rp_trademark_transfer_under_valuatio.task: 向战略发展总监指出低价向关联方转让无形资产缺乏定价公允性依据，审计需要重新评估商誉减值及关联方披露要求。

tgt: Could I finish this point first? It’s crucial for the context of our risk assessment.
I’ll be happy to address your questions in detail once I’ve walked through the summary.
Let’s hold the discussion until the end so we can keep the meeting on track.
traps: 使用“Stop interrupting me”，过于粗鲁，应说“Could I finish this point first?”。
使用“You are wasting our time”，攻击性太强，应说“Let's keep the meeting on track”。
使用“Be quiet”，带有下位者的命令感，应说“I'll be happy to address your questions in detail later”。
wk_cul_meeting_conflict.ai: 该法务认为你拖慢了会议进度，且不认为你的财务风险分析有他说的那么重要。
wk_cul_meeting_conflict.task: 在不破坏会议氛围的前提下，夺回话语权，要求对方等汇报结束后再提问。

tgt: Group control testing requires resolution of all bank reconciliation discrepancies, regardless of size.
Could you adjust the outstanding bank recon items for Mexico’s FY25 year-end?
Prompt resolution ensures the effectiveness of our control testing.
traps: 错误："Your bank recon has errors." 问题：负面指责，语气不专业；地道说法："We need to resolve the outstanding bank reconciliation items from Mexico."
错误："Fix the recon." 问题：口语化，不正式；地道说法："Could you complete the reconciliation of outstanding bank items?"
错误："They’re too small to matter." 问题：过于绝对，不符合控制测试要求；地道说法："All recon items need resolution for control testing purposes."
aud_grp_mexico_bank_recon.ai: Alex是墨西哥子公司组件审计项目经理，立场是异常金额小不影响控制，诉求是希望暂不调整。
aud_grp_mexico_bank_recon.task: 解释控制测试要求，要求调整异常项，确保控制测试有效性

tgt: You made RMB 30m inventory provision in FY25, which is not tax-deductible per tax rules.
Tax department requires adjusting taxable income—do you need to make accounting adjustments too?
The provision is reasonable in accounting—how do you handle the tax difference here?
traps: 错误表达：30 million inventory provision is not for tax. 问题：表达模糊，未明确税会差异，数字结构不规范；地道说法：You made RMB 30m inventory provision in FY25, which is not tax-deductible per tax rules.
错误表达：We need to change accounting because tax says so. 问题：语域生硬，专业场合需区分税会差异，表述更严谨；地道说法：Tax department requires adjusting taxable income—do you need to make accounting adjustments too?
错误表达：Provision is good for accounting—we follow tax rules. 问题：搭配错误，税会差异应称为tax-accounting difference，表述不专业；地道说法：The provision is reasonable in accounting—how do you handle the tax difference here?
dd_inv_tax_difference_provision.ai: Alex是公司税务专员，他认为会计和税务处理本就有差异，无需调整会计记录，诉求是维持现有会计处理。
dd_inv_tax_difference_provision.task: 与税务专员沟通存货减值的税会差异，解释FDD视角下减值计提的合理性，确认是否需要调整会计处理。

tgt: Would you mind doing me a huge favor and accepting a package arriving next Tuesday?
My friend will drop by your place to pick it up on the 18th.
I really appreciate your help since I'm flying out tomorrow morning.
traps: 说成 'Can you help me receive a express?' 'express' 不能作可数名词指快递，地道说法是 'accept a package'。
说成 'My friend will come to your home to take it.' 'take it' 听起来像要拿走什么战利品，地道说法是 'pick it up'。
说成 'Thank you because I leave tomorrow.' 语法杂糅，地道说法是 'I really appreciate your help since I'm flying out tomorrow morning.'
soc_farewell_neighbor_package.ai: Alex 是你的邻居。他很乐意帮忙，但提醒你下周他要出差五天，可能无法按时交接。
soc_farewell_neighbor_package.task: 妥善安排快递的代收时间，并商定朋友来取书的具体日期

tgt: Dr. Brown, let me introduce you to my friend Sarah. Sarah, this is Dr. Brown, he used to be my neighbor.
You two have both lived in the West District for years, right?
Actually, Sarah was just telling me about the new community garden opening up there.
traps: 说成 'He was my neighbor' 不如 'He used to be my neighbor' 表达过去状态更清晰
说成 'You two both lived' 这里用过去完成时 'have both lived' 描述持续时间更准确
说成 'Sarah was telling me about garden' 漏了冠词，应为 'the new community garden'
soc_intro_doctor_office.ai: Dr. Brown 非常专业，会追问 Sarah 的就诊目的，Sarah 觉得这是隐私，有些不悦。
soc_intro_doctor_office.task: 打破僵局，介绍两人认识，并将话题从就诊原因转移到更轻松的社区生活上。

tgt: I wasn't informed about the 30-day notice requirement when I signed up.
Is there any way to waive this charge since I haven't used the facility this month?
Could you please confirm in writing that my membership will be terminated immediately?
traps: 说成 'I want to cancel my membership for next month'，不够直接，应说 'I'd like to terminate my membership effective immediately.'
说成 'You didn't tell me this before'，语气太指责，应说 'I don't recall being notified of this policy.'
说成 'Can you give me a written paper?'，'paper' 太笼统，应说 'Could you send me a confirmation email?'
life_gym_membership_cancellation.ai: 健身房前台，立场是按合同办事，但他愿意尝试帮你申请经理审批，如果情况属实可能会酌情处理。
life_gym_membership_cancellation.task: 争取免掉这笔45美元的额外费用，并立刻取消续费

tgt: Hi, I wanted to have a quick word about your new puppy.
He tends to bark quite a bit during the day when you're out.
Is there any way we can work out a solution, like leaving the radio on?
traps: 说成 'Your dog shouts every day.'。狗叫不能用 'shout'（那是人喊），应该用 'bark'。
说成 'Your dog's noise makes me can't work.'。语法错误连篇，正确表达为 'The noise makes it hard for me to concentrate'。
说成 'You should buy a cage for him.'。直接建议关笼子显得有些粗鲁，用 'Is there any way we can...' 更温和。
life_nb_dog_barking.ai: Alex 扮演隔壁邻居，听到后有些不好意思，解释说小狗刚来还很不习惯分离焦虑，但他白天要上班也没办法，会问你有没有什么好建议。
life_nb_dog_barking.task: 委婉指出狗叫声干扰了你工作，并探讨可能的解决方法。

tgt: Let's look at the traffic report; a 3-hour lead time should be more than enough.
I'm worried that leaving 4 hours early will exhaust everyone before the flight.
Can we agree on a compromise and meet at 6:00 AM instead of 5:00 AM?
traps: 避免说 'You are too nervous'，人身攻击。应说 'I think we can be more efficient with our time.'
避免说 'I think 3 hours is enough to be on time'，不地道。应说 'Three hours should give us a comfortable buffer.'
避免说 'Why you want to leave so early'，语序错误。应说 'Why do you want to leave so early?'
soc_group_carpool_delay.ai: Alex是组织者，他认为宁可早到也不要误机，对于你的质疑感到很不耐烦。
soc_group_carpool_delay.task: 用数据说服他提前3小时出发是最佳方案，既保证安全又不至于太疲惫。

tgt: What kind of care do these roses need during autumn?
How often do you usually prune them?
I'm sharing some gardening tips on my personal blog.
traps: 说成 'How to make these flowers live well?' 养护植物应用 'care' 或 'maintenance'，修剪用 prune。
说成 'How many times do you cut them?' 修剪植物的标准动词是 prune，而不是用简单的 cut。
说成 'I write plants on my net.' 园艺博客应该说 'gardening tips on my personal blog'。
hob_write_community_garden.ai: Alex 扮演社区花园的资深园丁。他乐呵呵地跟你聊起养花经。
hob_write_community_garden.task: 向园丁请教月季养护要点并记录在笔记中

tgt: Sorry, I missed the gate number due to the noise. Could you repeat that?
Did you say gate B32 or B42?
Just to clarify, the flight to Beijing is now boarding from B42, right?
traps: 说成'Say again'，语气太生硬像命令。应使用'Could you please repeat that?'
问'What?'，非常没礼貌。应使用'Sorry, could you say that again?'
问'Is it B32 or B42?'，如果对方没听清你的确认，应加'Just to confirm,'。
life_clarify_flight_gate.ai: 地勤人员，正在忙于处理电子登机牌，他说话语速很快且有点焦急，需要你确认清楚后赶紧去正确的口。
life_clarify_flight_gate.task: 确认正确的登机口编号

tgt: Thank you for pointing that out; my phrasing was a bit awkward.
I would be more than happy to help your grandson with his beginner Chinese.
Shall we meet every Thursday evening for a one-hour session?
traps: 说成 'Thank you for telling me my English is wrong.'，显得过于生硬且伤自尊，地道说法是 'Thank you for pointing that out; my phrasing was a bit awkward.'。
说成 'I can teach your grandson Chinese.'，语气显得像个高价家教，用 'help your grandson with his beginner Chinese' 更有语伴的温和感。
说成 'Can we meet at Thursday night?'，介词应用 on，地道说法是 'every Thursday evening'。
hob_lang_community_board.ai: Alex 扮演退休老教师，性格热情但有点好为人师。她的立场是好意帮你改错，同时也希望通过互助帮家里孩子学点中文，但对成年人的发音要求比较严格。
hob_lang_community_board.task: 感谢对方指出错误，并谈妥互助的频次（比如每周四晚上）和各自教的内容

tgt: I have a history of a severe reaction to a specific ingredient, which caused my face to swell up.
Could you please cross-check these ingredients for me to ensure this is safe?
I’d appreciate it if you could confirm that none of these chemicals are related to my allergy.
traps: 说成 'I am allergic to some medicine.' 太含糊，应说 'I have a history of a severe reaction to...'。
说成 'Can you see if I die?' 表达错误，应说 'Ensure this is safe for me'。
说成 'Check this for me.' 缺乏语境，应说 'Could you cross-check these ingredients'。
life_doc_medicine_allergy.ai: 药房药剂师。正在核对药品库存，非常谨慎，不希望承担任何过敏建议的责任。
life_doc_medicine_allergy.task: 准确描述过敏经历，并要求药剂师核对该药品成分表。

tgt: Excuse me, could you step aside for 20 seconds?
I want to take a photo of sunset light on subway wall.
I won’t take long, I promise.
traps: 常将“地铁光影”直译为"subway light"，地道表达为"sunset light on subway wall"更具体；
常将“侧身挪一下”直译为"move sideways"，地道表达为"step aside"更礼貌；
常将“我不会久”错说为"I won’t take time"，地道表达为"I won’t take long"更自然。
hob_photo_subway_light.ai: Alex是地铁乘客，立场是配合，诉求是理解摄影的光影需求。
hob_photo_subway_light.task: 礼貌协商让乘客临时挪位拍光影

tgt: I started having red and itchy eyes, plus nonstop sneezing after being in Central Park yesterday.
Do you have over-the-counter allergy medicine that works for these symptoms?
How many times a day should I take this pill?
traps: 错误说法："I have allergy yesterday." 错误：时态错误应为过去时，名词all用法错误。地道："I started having red and itchy eyes, plus nonstop sneezing after being in Central Park yesterday."
错误说法："Give me the allergy medicine." 错误：语气粗鲁，不符合和药师沟通的礼貌语域。地道："Do you have over-the-counter allergy medicine that works for these symptoms?"
错误说法："Take this medicine two times." 错误："两次"常用twice而非two times，表达不地道。地道："How many times a day should I take this pill?"
life_doc_ny_pharmacy_allergy.ai: Alex是来纽约旅游的普通游客，对当地药品分类不熟，希望买到对症非处方过敏药。
life_doc_ny_pharmacy_allergy.task: 向药师描述过敏症状，买到合适的非处方过敏药，确认用法用量。

tgt: Excuse me, do you know how to use this charging station?
Do I need to download an app or can I just swipe my credit card?
How do I release the charging cable?
traps: 问怎么用充电桩说 "How to use this machine?"。缺少主谓结构，地道说法是 "How do you use this charging station?"
问刷卡还是下App说 "Use app or card?"。地道说法是 "Do I need to download an app or can I just swipe my card?"
问拔枪说 "How to take out the cable?"。地道说法是 "How do I release the charging cable?"
life_car_electric_charging.ai: Alex 是路过的热心车主，会耐心地教你如何扫码插枪。
life_car_electric_charging.task: 弄清楚如何启动这个充电桩给车充电

tgt: Is there any availability for an upgrade to business class today?
What would be the additional cost for an upgrade at the counter?
Does the upgrade include lounge access and extra baggage allowance?
traps: 说 'I want to upgrade'。有点像命令，应说 'I'm interested in an upgrade, is it possible?'。
说 'Can you give me a free upgrade?'。这在现代航司很难，应问 'Are there any promotional upgrade rates?'。
说 'Is it expensive?'。太笼统，应说 'Could you tell me the cost difference?'。
life_air_upgrade_request.ai: 值机职员。他检查了舱位情况，表示商务舱还有空位，但价格不菲，你需要评估是否值得。
life_air_upgrade_request.task: 询问升舱具体价格及待遇

tgt: I forgot my cricket bat, could I borrow yours for practice?
I’ll only use it for 1 hour and be super careful.
I’ll lend you my tennis racket later as a favor.
traps: 常说"borrow your bat"，地道表达应为"borrow your cricket bat"，避免歧义。
常说"I won’t break it"，语气绝对，地道表达应为"I’ll be extra careful with it"，更自然。
常说"you help me"，地道表达应为"could you do me a favor"，更礼貌客气。
hob_ball_cricket_bat_borrow.ai: Alex是你的板球队友，俱乐部常客，他的旧球拍用了3年，立场是不舍得但愿帮忙，诉求是确认使用时长，承诺小心使用。
hob_ball_cricket_bat_borrow.task: 说服队友借球拍，顺利练习1小时。

tgt: I am so deeply grateful for your support during that difficult moment.
I respect your professional boundaries, so I hope you’ll accept my sincere thanks.
Your support made a significant difference in my life, and I will always remember it.
traps: 使用 'I want to thank you with a gift' 应说 'I would like to express my sincere gratitude.'
使用 'You are the best' 显得太私人化，应说 'Your guidance was incredibly impactful.'
使用 'Why can't you take my gift?' 显得在质疑，应说 'I completely understand your position and respect your boundaries.'
soc_thanks_counselor_advice.ai: 你是咨询师，你必须维持专业的边界，坚决拒绝任何私人礼物的交换。
soc_thanks_counselor_advice.task: 真诚表达对危机干预的谢意，尊重对方的原则，同时确保心意被感受到。

tgt: Could I get the dressing on the side, please?
I'm trying to watch my calorie intake, so just a little bit of dressing is fine.
Could you put the dressing in a separate cup?
traps: 不要说 'Put the sauce apart'，'on the side' 是餐饮业固定搭配。
不要说 'I am eating for diet'，'diet' 在口语里指特定的食谱，说 'I'm watching my calorie intake' 或 'I'm watching my weight' 更准确。
不要说 'Don't give me the sauce'，这样显得太绝对，说 'on the side' 既委婉又清晰。
hob_diet_restaurant_order.ai: 服务员，同意你的要求，并询问你需要哪种特定的酱汁。
hob_diet_restaurant_order.task: 礼貌地要求沙拉酱分装（on the side）

tgt: That’s taking advantage of free samples—super annoying!
Does the store have sample limit rules?
I’d be frustrated too if I dealt with that daily.
traps: 错误：The customer is cheap. 问题：用词太贬低，不符合英语闲聊语气，地道说法：Taking too many free samples without buying is really rude.
错误：I also do that. 问题：太直接可能让对方尴尬，地道说法：That must be a hassle for store staff.
错误：You should ban them. 问题：语气太极端，地道说法：That’s such a frustrating thing to deal with.

soc_gossip_supermarket_cashier.task: 回应吐槽，保持友好，不随意评价。

tgt: Actually, I meant 10 visits a month for the basic membership, not 15—I just made a typo.
The basic package has all the facilities I need, like the main gym and group classes.
Can you amend my application to the basic year card for me?
traps: 错误说法："I write 15 times" → 语法错误，过去动作需用过去式，正确："I wrote 15 times"
错误说法："I want basic card" → 搭配错误，会员卡标准表述为membership，正确："I want the basic membership"
错误说法："Please correct my form" → 语域错误，此处为办卡申请，用application更准确，正确："Can you fix my application"
hob_gym_initial_membership.ai: Alex是FitNow健身房前台，职责是核对办卡信息匹配档位，诉求是确保客户办卡信息准确，帮客户选合适套餐
hob_gym_initial_membership.task: 向Alex说明填错数字，修正为10次并办理基础年卡

tgt: That bag looks incredibly heavy, do you need a hand with it?
I'm just over at plot 12, I've seen you working here a few times.
It’s a great way to spend a Saturday morning, isn't it?
traps: 说 'Give me that bag' 显得太强硬，应说 'Do you need a hand with it?'。
常说 'I saw you'，指代过去见过，应说 'I've seen you' 表示这段时间以来的观察。
误用 'It is a good way to spend time'，不如用 'It's a great way to spend a Saturday' 更具体地道。
soc_meet_community_garden.ai: Alex是你的邻居，他一个人搞不定，且因为腰疼而犹豫不决。
soc_meet_community_garden.task: 主动提议帮忙，并在协作中询问他是哪一户的。

tgt: Let's add up the power tokens and combat cards step by step.
I have the structural bonus from my bottom-row action, which accounts for the extra points.
My total combat strength is fully legitimate according to the player board.
traps: 用 'You are calculating wrong' 显得不够礼貌。地道说法是 'Let's double-check the math together to be sure.'
说 'My power is enough big' 犯了双重比较级错误。应说 'My combat value is high enough.'
使用 'Don't doubt me' 语气太冲。地道说法是 'You can check my board layout if you have any doubts.'
hob_chess_scythe_combat.ai: Alex 扮演玩家马克。他拿着记分纸，对你的战力上限提出了质疑，坚持要求你把刚才的战斗退回重来。
hob_chess_scythe_combat.task: 向马克逐一核对你的战力筹码和建筑加成，证明你的战力计算完全合规。

tgt: Excuse me, would you mind giving me a hand with this heavy suitcase?
It doesn't fit in the overhead rack. Can we put it at the end of the carriage?
Thanks so much for your help!
traps: 搭配错误：说成 "help me to move my luggage"。虽然能听懂，但请求别人搭把手最地道的固定搭配是 "give me a hand"。
词汇混淆：把大行李箱说成 "bag"。28寸大箱子通常用 "suitcase" 或 "luggage"。
句型生硬：说成 "Can you help me? My bag is big."。缺乏委婉客套，用 "Would you mind..." 会更自然友好。
life_train_luggage_rack.ai: Alex 扮演友善的邻座乘客，会微笑着站起来帮你把箱子调整角度塞进了行李架。
life_train_luggage_rack.task: 请邻座乘客帮忙把大行李箱安置妥当

tgt: I suppose everyone is just trying to keep up with the pace of the city.
It’s a shame to lose that tradition, but maybe there's still a place for slow moments.
I find that the faster the city, the more we crave those quiet, meaningful experiences.
traps: 说成 'They are fast in everything'，应用 'They are always in a rush'。
说成 'They don't have ritual'，仪式感应用 'sense of ritual'。
说成 'The city is too hurry'，hurry是动词，形容城市应为 'The city is fast-paced'。
talk_city_culture_clash.ai: 老板娘觉得现代城市节奏太疯狂，她想怀念那种大家慢慢聊天的日子。
talk_city_culture_clash.task: 安抚对方并探讨‘高效’与‘生活质量’之间的平衡。

tgt: To me, the vintage aesthetic easily justifies the price tag.
I don't mind paying for the character and history this piece holds.
Even with the service cost, it's still cheaper than buying a modern reissue.
traps: 直译“这块表有历史”为 This watch has history，不如说 hold a lot of history 或 carry great vintage charm 地道。
表达“修理费”时用 fix fee，应为 repair cost 或 servicing fee。
表达“物有所值”时用 worth the price，口语里常说 pay off 或 be worth every penny。
talk_shopop_vintage_watch.ai: Alex 扮演跳蚤市场的老摊主兼修表匠。他坦率地指出这块表机芯老化，修理费还要另加 150 美元，提醒你其实买贵了。
talk_shopop_vintage_watch.task: 向 Alex 解释你不仅看重实用性，更看重这块表独特的复古设计和收藏价值，这钱花得值。

tgt: Hi, I noticed the power outlet is different from my plug. Do you happen to have an adapter I could borrow?
My laptop is running out of battery, so it would be a huge help.
I'll make sure to leave it on the table before I check out.
traps: 说成 'My plug is not good'，表达模糊。应说 'My plug doesn't fit the outlet'。
说成 'Can you give me an adapter?'。应说 'Could I borrow an adapter?'。
说成 'I will leave it on the table'，语态略显生硬，应说 'I'll make sure to leave it...'
soc_borrow_adapter.ai: 房东。他回复说家里有备用的，可以放到门口的信箱里。
soc_borrow_adapter.task: 描述插头不匹配的问题，并请求借用适配器

tgt: Hi, sorry to bother you, I'm drawing here and my black colored pencil broke.
Could I borrow a black colored pencil of the same type as yours for a second?
I can give it back to you right after I finish using it.
traps: 错误表达："Give me your black pencil." 原因：命令式语气，不礼貌，需用求助式，地道表达为：Could I borrow a black colored pencil of the same type.
错误表达："I need black pencil." 原因：表述笼统，需明确是同型号，地道表达为：a black colored pencil of the same type.
错误表达："I return it soon." 原因：搭配不当，地道表达为：give it back to you right after I finish using it.
hob_draw_pencil_borrow_request.ai: Alex是写生者，礼貌求助，无强求，诉求是借到同型号黑色彩铅。
hob_draw_pencil_borrow_request.task: 向路人礼貌求助，借一支同型号的黑色彩铅。

tgt: I usually maintain a steady pace of 5:00 per kilometer for long runs.
I'm looking for a group that runs between 4:45 and 5:15 pace.
Will the group be doing a consistent pace or is it more of a progression run?
traps: 说 'My speed is 12 km per hour'。跑者通常用 'pace' 即 'min/km'，不要用km/h。
说 'I can run with you guys'。不够具体，应说 'I can keep up with the 5:00 min/km group'。
说 'I am a fast runner'。主观词没意义，应用 'I consistently run a sub-3:30 marathon'。
hob_run_local_running_club.ai: 跑团领队。欢迎新人，但担心你跟不上他们的节奏导致队伍分裂，需要确认你的体能状态。
hob_run_local_running_club.task: 描述你的配速，并表达你能适应他们训练强度。

tgt: The author makes some great points, but some of the case studies feel a bit outdated for 2026.
It touches on a very real pain point that most practitioners face daily.
I feel like it skims over the actual friction we encounter on the ground.
traps: 使用 'The book is old'。评价书籍内容过时用 'outdated' 或 'doesn't reflect the current landscape'。
使用 'It hits the problem'。表达切中痛点用 'hit on a real pain point'。
使用 'It doesn't talk much about...'。地道表达可用 'It glosses over the actual friction...'。

talk_work_bookstore_chat.task: 分享你对这本书所涉及行业趋势的看法，并指出书中的局限

tgt: I try to drink at least two liters of water a day.
Carrying a reusable water bottle with me really helps.
You might find it easier if you set reminders on your phone.
traps: 说成 'I drink two liters water'，地道说法是 'two liters of water'。
说成 'It is easy to do'，地道说法是 'It helps to form the habit'。
说成 'You should drink more water'，语气过于命令，地道建议是 'You might want to try...'
talk_health_water_intake.ai: 朋友 Eric，他觉得每天喝 2 升水很难，向你请教如何养成喝水习惯。
talk_health_water_intake.task: 分享你随身携带水瓶的习惯，并鼓励对方多喝水。

tgt: I left the pie in the oven for five minutes too long, so the crust edges got totally charred.
I'm just trimming off the burnt parts with a serrated knife before serving it to everyone.
Could you grab some dessert plates from the cabinet while I finish fixing this?
traps: 把派皮‘烤焦了’说成 'The crust is black.'。地道动词用 charred 或 burnt to a crisp。
说‘用锯齿刀切掉’说成 'cut with a sharp knife'。切面包或派皮的锯齿刀应该用 'serrated knife'。

hob_cook_pie_crust_burnt.ai: 提前到的热心朋友。他提着一瓶红酒提前敲门进屋，看到你正拿着一把锯齿刀在案板上紧张地修剪派皮边缘。
hob_cook_pie_crust_burnt.task: 向提前到的朋友解释焦边情况，并请他帮忙一起把烤焦的部分切掉修饰。

tgt: It's frustrating to pay four dollars for a ride and still get delayed by outdated signals.
Upgrading the signaling system takes time, but commuters shouldn't bear the full cost.
Signing a petition might help, but I doubt the transit authority will lower the fare anytime soon.
traps: 错用 'pay for the ticket'。地道说法是 'pay for a ride' 或 'pay the fare'。
误用 'old signals'。新闻或正式讨论中更常说 'outdated signaling system'。
直译 'write a letter is useless'。地道表达是 'I doubt it will change anything' 或 'It won't make much difference'。
talk_news_subway_delay.ai: Alex 扮演通勤乘客萨拉。她对票价上涨非常不满，觉得管理层尸位素餐。她会顺着新闻吐槽，并问你觉得是不是该给市长写抗议信。
talk_news_subway_delay.task: 回应萨拉的吐槽，在表达同感的同时，理性分析公共设施升级需要时间和资金。

tgt: Should I take this on a full stomach or on an empty one?
Are there any common side effects I should watch out for?
Does this mean I should avoid driving after taking it?
traps: 说成 'Can I eat?' 语意不明，应改为 'Should I take this with food?'
说成 'Any bad things?' 显得太口语化，应改为 'Are there any potential side effects?'
说成 'I take once or twice?' 语法错误，应改为 'How often should I take this?'
talk_ask_doctor_prescription.ai: 你是医生，耐心解释药效，并提醒这药可能会让人有点犯困。
talk_ask_doctor_prescription.task: 通过追问，明确服药的时间点以及是否能驾车。

tgt: Wait, can we stack plus-two cards in this game or not?
Ah, I see. In my usual group, we always stack them.
Fine, I'll take the four cards from the pile then.
traps: 使用 'Can we plus two together?'，动词 'plus' 不能这样当动词短语用，地道说法是 'stack plus-two cards' 或 'stack the draws'。
使用 'In my usual game group'，'group' 虽然没错，但桌游圈更常说 'gaming group' 或 'game night group'。
使用 'I will take four cards'，加上介词从哪里拿会更具体，地道说法是 'draw four cards from the deck'。
hob_chess_uno_draw_stack.ai: 路易斯，你的朋友。他笑着摆手阻止你的出牌动作，解释他们平时聚会不采用累加罚牌的house rule。
hob_chess_uno_draw_stack.task: 跟路易斯确认这个桌子的具体规矩，决定是乖乖摸4张牌还是把牌收回来

tgt: I know editing photos takes time, but their shrimp dumplings are totally worth waking up early for.
We can look through your new photos while having brunch together.
Let's aim for 10 AM this Sunday at Imperial Garden.
traps: 使用 "Their dumplings are good so you need to wake up early." 因果关系太硬。地道表达是 "...are totally worth waking up early for."
使用 "We can see your pictures during eating." 语法错误。地道说法是 "...while having brunch together."
使用 "Let's choose 10 AM." 动词搭配不地道。约定具体时间习惯用 "Let's aim for 10 AM..."
soc_invite_dimsum_brunch.ai: Alex 扮演摄影师 Chris。他觉得周日早上要修图可能起不来，想把时间改到下午喝下午茶。
soc_invite_dimsum_brunch.task: 用早茶的美味和新鲜虾饺吸引 Chris，让他答应早起吃早茶。

tgt: Excuse me, is this controller compatible with the PS5?
Do you know if this works with a PlayStation 5 console?
I want to make sure this connects to my PS5 before I buy it.
traps: 不要说 'Is this controller fit my PS5?'，fit 做形容词时用法不同。地道说法是 'Is this compatible with...?'。
不要说 'Can I use this for PS5?'，虽不错但不够专业，店员更常用 'compatible'。
不要说 'Does it connect to PS5 well?'，太啰嗦且中式。地道说法是 'Does it work with...?'。
talk_game_console_store.ai: Alex 是店员，他很专业且耐心，会查看包装盒上的参数并给你肯定的答复。
talk_game_console_store.task: 向店员确认该手柄是否兼容你的主机。

tgt: Sorry to bother you, could you point me to the exit for the National Gallery?
I'm a bit lost, is this the right way?
Thank you, I appreciate your help.
traps: 错用“Where is the National Gallery?”：太突兀。加个“Sorry to bother you”作为开场白更符合社交习惯。
错用“Show me the way”：像是指挥别人带路，语气不妥。使用“Could you point me to...”更合适。
错用“You are very kind”：虽然没错，但用“I appreciate your help”回复别人指路会更自然地道。
soc_favor_subway_directions.ai: 你是路人，虽然也赶时间，但很乐意指出方向，告诉你应该走B出口。
soc_favor_subway_directions.task: 准确咨询路线并请求指引

tgt: Emma, look at the floor of your room; you need to clean up this mess before dinner time.
Put the dirty clothes into the hamper, place your books back on the shelf, and toss the wrappers into the bin.
A tidy room will make it much easier for you to find your school uniform tomorrow morning.
traps: “清理乱七八糟的东西”动词短语是 clean up this mess，如果说 clean your room 有时不够具体指向地板上的杂物。
“脏衣篓”地道词汇是 hamper，而不是用 laundry basket（虽然也能懂，但 hamper 更口语自然）。
“扔进垃圾桶”用 toss the wrappers into the bin 比 throw into trash can 听起来更生动、更生活化。
soc_parent_messy_room.ai: Alex 扮演女儿 Emma，正坐在床上玩手机，觉得自己的房间自己做主，反问为什么一定要现在收拾。
soc_parent_messy_room.task: 要求女儿在晚饭前把房间地板上的杂物全部归位

tgt: I’m so sorry about the noise; I had no idea he was barking while I was out.
I’ll definitely look into getting a pet camera or some quiet toys to keep him occupied.
Is there a specific time when you have important meetings so I can try to be home?
traps: 不要说 'Dogs just bark, you know'，这显得完全不把对方困扰当回事，应说 'I understand how frustrating that must be'。
不要说 'He never does that'，除非你有证据，否则这样说会显得你在撒谎，应说 'I’ll look into why he’s behaving this way'。
不要用 'You are complaining too much'，应用 'I appreciate you bringing this to my attention'。
talk_pet_neighbor_noise.ai: Alex 是邻居，他因为刚才的会议被干扰而感到烦躁，他并不想找茬，只是希望你能解决噪音问题。
talk_pet_neighbor_noise.task: 承认问题，表示歉意，并提出你会采取什么措施（比如买个摄像头监控或给狗准备玩具）。

tgt: I know you hate to waste food, but eating food kept for three days isn't good for your stomach.
Let's just toss this one out, and I'll pick up some fresh pork ribs tomorrow morning.
It's not about being picky; it's just that leftover meat loses its nutrition and can easily upset your digestion.
traps: 直译 'you cannot eat this' 显得态度生硬。地道劝阻应用 'It might not be the best idea to finish this'。
用 'waste money' 翻译心疼粮食不够准确。长辈心疼的是物资，应用 'hate to waste food' 或 'don't like throwing things away'。
反驳长辈时用 'You are wrong' 太直接。委婉表达不同观点应用 'I get your point, but health comes first'。
soc_elder_diet_habits.ai: Alex 扮演你的母亲。她认为现在的年轻人太浪费，坚信加热透了就没问题，并试图反驳你偶尔也在外面吃外卖不健康。
soc_elder_diet_habits.task: 劝说母亲倒掉这碗隔夜汤，并答应明天亲自买新鲜排骨给她做红烧排骨。

tgt: That sounds like fun, but I already have plans for this weekend.
I usually use weekends to rest and recharge my batteries.
Have a great party though, and congrats again on the new place!
traps: 使用 'I have no time this weekend' 显得你在抱怨工作多或者语气生硬，用 'I already have plans' 是更标准且不容反驳的客套拒绝。
使用 'I do not want to go to your home' 听起来非常粗鲁，缺乏基本的职场人际礼貌。
使用 'I need to sleep at home' 显得过于随性，用 'I use weekends to rest and recharge' 听起来更成熟得体。
soc_bound_colleague_weekend.ai: Alex 是公司行政同事，为人热情好客，他会极力劝说大家都会去，而且离你住的地方不远，希望你别扫兴。
soc_bound_colleague_weekend.task: 婉拒周末的聚会邀请，不让对方觉得你在针对他

tgt: Brenda, I'm returning my final two books because I'm moving out of the area.
Here is 10 dollars for the late fee, and I'd like to close my account.
Thank you for helping me find so many good reads.
traps: 说成 'give back books' 比较口语且略显单调，归还图书馆图书用 'returning books' 更准确。
说 'close my card' 听着像银行卡，图书馆借书证通常说 'close my account' 或 'cancel my membership'。
说 'good books' 也可以，但书虫之间说 'good reads' 显得更有生活情趣。
soc_farewell_librarian.ai: 图书管理员 Brenda 帮你办好了手续，收了 10 美元罚款，笑着递给你一张纪念书签作为临别纪念。
soc_farewell_librarian.task: 还书、交清 10 美元罚款并办理注销

tgt: I've noticed that the interior windows and the top of the cabinets were missed during the cleaning.
The contract specifies 'full-house deep cleaning,' which should cover these areas.
Could you send someone back to finish these spots, or issue a partial refund?
traps: Saying 'You didn't clean well' is too broad. Use 'Certain areas were missed during the service.'
Saying 'I want my money back' is confrontational. Use 'I'd like to request a partial refund.'
Saying 'It is in the paper' is wrong. Use 'It is clearly stated in our service agreement.'
talk_home_cleaning_service.ai: 清洁公司领班，辩解说合同只涵盖“常规清洁”，不包括高处作业和窗户。
talk_home_cleaning_service.task: 指出服务未达标的细节，要求对方补做或者退回部分款项

tgt: A 25% hike is quite a significant jump to take in all at once.
I understand the rising costs, but does this reflect the current market trend?
Could we perhaps meet halfway to make this more sustainable for me?
traps: 不要说 'Your price is too expensive'，这会让房东觉得你对他个人不满。应说 'The rent increase is quite steep'。
不要说 'I want to bargain'，听起来像菜市场吵架。用 'Could we discuss the terms?' 或 'Is there any flexibility?'。
不要说 'It's not fair'，像在撒娇。应说 'I'm concerned about the affordability given the current rates'。
talk_money_airbnb_deposit.ai: 房东，他很实在，详细列举了水电和公共设施维护费用的增加，认为这个涨幅是必须的。
talk_money_airbnb_deposit.task: 委婉表达租金涨幅过高，尝试争取一个折中方案。

tgt: I get why fans are mad, but books and movies are totally different mediums.
You can't expect a two-hour film to capture every single detail of a 500-page novel.
The visual adaptation actually exceeded my expectations.
traps: 说成 'Books and movies are different media.'。虽然 media 是复数，但在讨论艺术形式时，用 mediums 作为复数形式指代不同媒介更符合口语习惯。
说成 'You cannot let a film to capture everything.'。动词 let 的用法错误，且结构啰嗦，地道说法是 'You can't expect a film to capture...'。
说成 'The movie is better than I thought.'。表达超出预期可以更地道地说 'exceeded my expectations'。
talk_movie_bookstore_adaptation.ai: Alex，书店店员兼原著书粉。他非常激进地认为电影改编完全失败，并反问你是不是觉得好莱坞只懂搞视觉特效而不在乎深度。
talk_movie_bookstore_adaptation.task: 辩证地看待改编电影，认为虽然有删改但视觉呈现依然不错

tgt: How much deposit do I need to pay to secure a booster box pre-order?
Can I pick it up in store on the official release day?
Does this pre-order come with any promo cards or special merchandise?
traps: 询问定金时直译错误：不宜说 'How much first money to pay?'，地道说法应用 'How much deposit do I need to pay?'。
询问自提时搭配不对：不宜说 'Can I take it back by myself?'，地道说法应用 'Can I pick it up in store?'。
询问特典时用词中式：不宜说 'Are there any gift cards?'，地道说法应用 'Does this come with any promo cards?'。
talk_game_tcg_preorder.ai: Alex 是店长，他会告诉你这款补充包目前的预定名额还剩多少，以及全款和定金的具体金额。
talk_game_tcg_preorder.task: 问清预定一盒需要付多少定金、发售当天能不能来店里自提，以及是否有预定特典卡

tgt: Hi, I'm terribly sorry, but I've had terrible insomnia due to jet lag and my head is pounding.
Would you mind terribly turning down the radio just a little bit?
I'm probably just going to close my eyes for the rest of the ride if you don't mind.
traps: 说成 'Turn off the radio, it's too noisy.'，对网约车司机这样说过于生硬无礼，地道表达是 'Would you mind turning down the radio?'。
说成 'My head is painful.'，头痛的地道表达是 'my head is pounding' 或 'I have a headache'，一般不说 'painful'。
说成 'I want to sleep in your car.'，听起来怪异，表达“眯一会儿/闭目养神”用 'close my eyes for a bit' 更地道。
hob_sleep_uber_silent_ride.ai: Alex 扮演网约车司机，听到要求后会立刻把音乐调小，并抱歉地表示自己没注意到你累了，随后保持安静专心开车。
hob_sleep_uber_silent_ride.task: 礼貌请司机调低音乐并告知自己需要闭目养神

tgt: Hi, I bought sirloin steak here an hour ago, but I got chuck roast instead.
I asked for sirloin at 24 dollars a kilo, but this is clearly stewing beef.
Could you please exchange this for the right cut?
traps: 说成 'You give me wrong meat.'，语法有误且不够礼貌，地道说法是 'I asked for sirloin, but I got chuck roast instead.'
说成 'This meat is wrong type.'，中式英语搭配，地道说法是 'This is the wrong cut.'
说成 'Change it for me.'，语气过于生硬像命令，地道说法是 'Could you please exchange this for the right cut?'
life_food_butcher_wrong_cut.ai: Alex 扮演肉铺店员。他一开始会凭印象说自己没切错，需要你拿实物或包装标签跟他对质。
life_food_butcher_wrong_cut.task: 拿着错的肉回去找店员，要求换成正确的牛里脊

tgt: Hi, the washing machine number 3 didn't spin my clothes dry.
The laundry is still soaking wet and the cycle ended early.
Can I get a refund or use another machine?
traps: 说成 'The washing machine doesn't dewater'。'dewater' 是工业和科学用语，生活英语中洗衣机脱水应该用 'spin' 或 'spin dry'。
说成 'My clothes are very wet' 略显单薄，形容湿透的状态用 'soaking wet' 会更地道传神。
要求退钱说成 'Give me my money back' 语气太冲、像在吵架，礼貌请求应该用 'Can I get a refund?'。
life_neigh_washing_machine.ai: Alex 扮演公寓维护人员，态度很好，会查看机器并告诉你如何处理或退币。
life_neigh_washing_machine.task: 向管理员反映共用洗衣机故障

tgt: Public transit fares seem to creep up every single year.
Is the city cutting subsidies for the tram network again?
At this rate, getting a secondhand bicycle is definitely the cheaper route.
traps: use "The ticket price goes up every year"，every single year 比 every year 更有强调感和口语感。
use "Cheaper way"，比喻路线或方案用 cheaper route 或 better option 更地道。
use "Cut down money for tram"，资金补贴应用 subsidies 或 funding，不用 money。
talk_money_amsterdam_transit.ai: Alex 扮演电车售票员，语气友好地回答说公共交通运营补贴减少，人工和车辆维护成本都在逐年递增。
talk_money_amsterdam_transit.task: 向售票员了解城市公共交通票价上涨的背景

tgt: Could you check if any of your other branches still have the hardcover in stock?
Is it possible to put a hold on a copy for me from the next shipment?
When exactly is the paperback edition scheduled to arrive?
traps: 使用 'Can you help me call other shop?'，shop 偏小，连锁店应用 branch 或 store。
使用 'Can you keep one for me?' 表达可以但不够地道，应用 'Could you hold a copy for me?'。
使用 'When will the book come?' 略显生硬，应用 'When is the book expected to arrive?'。
talk_ask_bookstore_event.ai: Alex 扮演书店店员。他查了电脑说精装版已经卖完了，平装版要下周才到，需要你追问附近分店是否有货。
talk_ask_bookstore_event.task: 请店员帮忙查一下离这里最近的另一家分店是否还有现货，并能否帮忙留一本。

tgt: I'm actually just here to enjoy my book and some quiet time.
I'm not really up for a conversation right now, but thanks anyway.
I'd prefer to be left alone for the rest of the evening.
traps: 说'Go away'，这在社交场合极具攻击性，应说'I'd prefer to be left alone'。
说'Why are you bothering me?'，这会引发争执，地道表达是'I'm not really up for a conversation right now'。
说'Stop talking to me'，太像命令，建议用'I appreciate it, but I'd like to enjoy my drink by myself'。
life_no_bar_stranger.ai: Alex是酒吧里的熟客，他性格外向且好奇心重，觉得一个人坐着喝酒很无聊，想和你聊天并为你点一杯酒。
life_no_bar_stranger.task: 礼貌但明确地拒绝对方的对话请求，结束尴尬的交流。

tgt: I sincerely apologize, I didn't realize that crossing the yellow line was prohibited.
I’m happy to delete the photo if that’s the rule, I didn't mean to cause any trouble.
Thank you for the warning, I will be much more careful from now on.
traps: 错误说“I don't know it's a forbidden area”。应说“I was not aware that...”显得更地道。
错误说“Why are you so angry?”激化矛盾。应说“I apologize for the misunderstanding”化解尴尬。
错误说“It's just a small photo”试图说服对方。对方执行任务时，直接道歉和配合是最佳策略。
life_tour_restricted_area.ai: Alex是安保人员。他语气严厉地指出你的行为违反了规定，要求你立即删除照片。
life_tour_restricted_area.task: 道歉并说明自己不知道禁区，尝试保留照片或友好离场

tgt: I'm planning to hunt for some old vinyl records this Sunday.
Would you like to check out that vintage bookstore with me at 3 PM?
We can grab afternoon tea nearby afterwards.
traps: 用了 'find old books'。淘旧书用 'hunt for old books' 或 'browse for used books' 更生动。
用了 'drink tea in the afternoon'。下午茶固定说法是 'have afternoon tea' 或 'grab afternoon tea'。
用了 'old book store'。旧书店、二手书店标准表达是 'secondhand bookstore' 或 'used bookstore'。
soc_invite_secondhand_bookstore.ai: Alex 扮演 Lucas，他对那家旧书店也垂涎已久，立刻答应了时间。
soc_invite_secondhand_bookstore.task: 成功约到 Lucas 本周日下午 3 点去旧书店和喝茶。

tgt: You gave me the adult-strength formula instead of the pediatric version by mistake.
Giving the wrong dosage to a child could be extremely dangerous.
Please exchange this immediately and double-check the item before handing it over.
traps: 说拿错了用 'You give me wrong medicine.' 时态错误且搭配不佳，应用 gave me... by mistake。
说儿童版用 'children medicine'，专业且地道的表达应用 pediatric version。
让双重检查说 'You must check two times.' 中式直译，地道说法应用 double-check the item。
life_emo_pharmacy_consult.ai: Alex 扮演药剂师。他会拿过药盒核对小票，意识到自己拿错了货，会赶忙道歉并准备更换，需要你指出这种粗心对儿童用药安全的潜在风险。
life_emo_pharmacy_consult.task: 向药剂师指出拿错药的失误，要求更换正确的儿童版并表达对用药安全的担忧

tgt: If I take my ski boots out of this bag and carry them in my backpack, will that bring the weight under the 23-kilogram limit?
Can we re-weigh the bag now that I’ve removed the heavy boots?
Is it possible to waive the overweight fee since the boots qualify as a separate piece of sports equipment?
traps: 常说“Can you give me free weight？”，“free weight”在健身里是哑铃杠铃，在机场应该说“waive the fee”或“free allowance”。
常说“I take out my boots.”，描述刚刚完成的动作或假设条件应用完成时态或条件句，地道说法应用“Now that I have removed...”。
常说“My bag is too heavy, but it's just skis.”，“just skis”逻辑不通，因为超重往往是因为把靴子和头盔也塞进去了，应用“It's standard ski gear mixed with boots”。
hob_ski_excess_luggage.ai: Alex 扮演值机柜台的地勤人员。他按照公司行李标准公事公办，但看到你把沉重的雪鞋（Ski Boots）塞在包里，正准备提醒你其实可以把雪鞋单独作为一个随身背包免费携带。
hob_ski_excess_luggage.task: 跟柜台沟通能否将滑雪鞋从包里拿出来单独手提，从而把雪包总重降到 22 公斤以免除超重费。

tgt: I'm a visitor here, and I honestly found the parking signage a bit confusing. Is there a formal process to appeal this citation?
I didn't intend to ignore the regulations. Could you please check if this is my first offense in this district?
Is there any way to have this converted into a warning instead of a formal fine?
traps: 说 'You give me a ticket, I don't like it' 显得无理。应说 'I'd like to contest this fine as I'm a tourist and misunderstood the signage'。
说 'It's too expensive' 显得像付不起钱。应说 'Is there any room for leniency given my situation?'。
说 'You must cancel it' 是命令语气。应说 'Could you advise on how I might file an appeal?'。
hob_car_parking_fine.ai: 窗口办事员。他表示标志很清楚，罚款是自动生成的，他无权撤销。
hob_car_parking_fine.task: 委婉表达自己并非恶意违停，询问是否有申诉程序

tgt: Excuse me, I'm terribly sorry to interrupt, but my phone just died and I'm waiting for an urgent visa email. Would you mind terribly if I borrowed your charger cable for just ten or fifteen minutes?
I'll keep a close eye on it right here at my table.
You're a lifesaver, thank you so much.
traps: 直接说 'Can I use your charger?' 显得有些唐突和不客气。加上 'Would you mind terribly if I...' 才是标准且礼貌的求助句型。
说 'I will watch it' 不如用 'I'll keep a close eye on it' 更地道，表示你会好好看管别人的财物。
说 'Thank you very much' 略显死板。用 'You're a lifesaver' 表达在紧急关头得到帮助的感激最对味。
soc_borrow_charger_cafe.ai: Alex 扮演坐在旁边的顾客本。他正在用电脑处理自己的事情，看到你走过来搭话，摘下一只耳机看着你。
soc_borrow_charger_cafe.task: 向邻座陌生人借用十五分钟的充电线应急

tgt: I just bought a sturdy umbrella for 15 dollars, and I already left it at the cafe.
I only had it for thirty minutes! I can't believe how scatterbrained I am.
It’s pouring outside, so now I have to go back and check if it’s still there.
traps: 说成 'I lose my umbrella'，应为 'I left it' (遗忘在某处)。
说成 'How absent-minded I am'，用 'scatterbrained' 更地道地形容那种丢三落四的状态。
说成 'The rain is heavy'，用 'It's pouring' 更形象且地道。
soc_family_lost_umbrella.ai: Alex 是你的朋友，他/她会觉得你很健忘，并开玩笑说你给咖啡馆留下了纪念品。

Oh, I had no idea about the gate code change. Thanks for the heads-up!
It's really nice living in such a helpful neighborhood.
traps: 道谢时说 'Thank you for help me receive the package.'。介词后动词要用动名词，应该说 'Thanks for picking up that package for me.'。

My apologies, I completely missed the end of the line. I’ll move to the back immediately.

hob_ski_lesson_cancellation.ai: 滑雪学校前台。她认为安排另一位教练是补偿方案，但你担心这位教练的专业资质不够。

tgt: Related party receivables and payables should only be offset if there is a legally enforceable right of set-off and an intention to settle net.
Netting related party balances is not allowed under IFRS unless specific criteria are met, even if the parties are related.
For net debt calculation, gross interest-bearing related party balances should be used unless netting is permitted.
traps: Saying "offset related party balances directly" is incorrect without confirming the legal set-off right, which is a common mistake for Chinese finance teams.
Using "net debt" to refer to net related party balances is a terminology error; the correct term is "gross related party debt/ receivables" before netting.
Translating "法定抵销权" as "legal right" is too vague, the proper professional term is "legally enforceable right of set-off".
dd_debt_related_party_offset.ai: Alex是目标公司的财务总监，他觉得关联方往来净额列报可以简化尽调报表，想了解国际尽调中的通行做法。

tgt: The company is in a net liability position of 15 million at FY25 year-end, so going concern hinges on the FY26 forecast.
I've stress-tested the key assumptions — revenue growth and gross margin — and they look aggressive relative to the 9M26 actuals.
If we're not comfortable the forecast is achievable, we may need to consider a qualified opinion rather than an unmodified one.
traps: 「The company is negative equity」直译「负净资产」可懂但不地道；财务上用 in a net liability position / net liabilities exceed net assets 更标准。
「The forecast is very optimistic」中 optimistic 偏主观情绪词；表达「预测假设偏激进」用 the assumptions appear aggressive / the forecast lacks sufficient support 更专业。
「We should give a qualified opinion」搭配不当，审计意见用 issue / express，应说 issue a qualified opinion；且 opinion 前要带 qualified / unmodified 等修饰语，不能单说 give an opinion。
aud_gc_negative_equity.ai: Alex 扮演审计合伙人。他务实平和，想先听你对扭亏预测的评估，关心预测假设是否站得住、是否影响意见类型，而不是急着下结论。
aud_gc_negative_equity.task: 向合伙人汇报对FY26F扭亏预测的评估结论，说明是否存在重大不确定性及对审计意见类型的影响。

tgt: A draft forecast works for now, as long as the key assumptions are spelled out.
We need to wrap up the going concern assessment this week, so I can't wait for the final version.
Can you walk me through the assumptions so I can see where the numbers land?
traps: “模型还在调”直译说 the model is still adjusting —— adjust 主语应是人不是物；应说 we're still tweaking the model / the forecast is being updated。
“给你个半成品”说 give you a half-done —— half-done 不作名词且不专业；“半成品”地道说 a working draft / a preliminary version。
“我等你两天”说 I will wait you two days —— wait 后不能直接接时长，且 wait you 缺 for；应说 I can give it two more days / I can hold off for two days。
aud_plan_cashflow_forecast.ai: Alex 扮演客户财务总监（分管司库）。他不是不想给，而是老板刚改了几个收入假设，他怕交了又得改，想再等两天定稿；他愿意先给你看半成品。
aud_plan_cashflow_forecast.task: 本周内拿到可支撑持续经营评估的预测版本（哪怕标注draft），并明确假设来源，不让“再等两天”无限拖延。

tgt: What does the environmental indemnity in the SPA cover — is it capped, and for how long?
Did the Phase I assessment flag any recognised environmental conditions?
Can we establish that the contamination post-dated the closing?
traps: 把“卖了地”说成 'sold the land'——偏口语；公司资产处置语境更精确的是 'divested the site' 或 'disposed of the property'。
把“发现污染”说成 'discovered pollution'——soil 的“污染”专业用 contamination；表达应是 'identified contamination'。
把“责任划分时点”说成 'responsibility time point'——不是地道搭配；应说 'the allocation of liability' 或 'the cut-off for liability'。
dd_cont_contaminated_land.ai: Alex扮演总法律顾问。他从合同条款和初勘报告讲起，认为SPA有明确的责任划分时点、初勘未发现重大污染。他专业地讨论、不回避诉讼，但认为公司站得住。
dd_cont_contaminated_land.task: 核实SPA环境赔偿条款的触发条件与上限、初勘报告范围与结论、污染的因果关系时点，评估败诉敞口。

tgt: The HKD 200 million investment property was valued by management's external valuer — how did you assess the valuer's competence and objectivity?
Could you talk me through your review of the key assumptions, like the capitalisation rate and discount rate?
I want to be clear on what you reviewed versus what you didn't re-perform, so we take a consistent approach.
traps: 说成 “how did you check the valuer's ability”——“ability” 直译“能力”，指专业人员胜任能力应用 “competence”；“check” 应为 “assess”，应说 “How did you assess the valuer's competence”。
说成 “what is the capitalization rate you used”——时态错（前任的工作应用过去时），且主语错（用比率的是估值师不是审计师）；应为 “What capitalisation rate did the valuer apply”，HK 口径也常用英式拼写 “capitalisation”。
说成 “you didn't re-do the valuation”——“re-do” 偏口语；专业说法 “re-perform”，应说 “You didn't re-perform the valuation”。
aud_oa_management_expert_valuer.ai: Alex 扮演前任审计经理。他能讲清对估值师的资质复核和独立性确认程序，以及关键假设的复核过程。他希望把“我们复核了什么”和“我们没有重新评估价值”区分开。
aud_oa_management_expert_valuer.task: 了解前任对管理层估值师的胜任能力与独立性复核程序，及对关键假设的复核。

tgt: Could you walk me through how the landlord's fit-out contribution was recorded?

Is there any written agreement specifying that the 600,000 is a lease incentive?
traps: 中国人常说 “The landlord gave us money, so it's income.” —— 直译“给了钱就是收入”显得武断；地道的说法是 “The incentive was received from the lessor, so we need to assess whether it should be netted off.” 用 assess / netted off，而不是 give / income。
把“冲减使用权资产”说成 “minus the ROU asset” —— minus 是算术口语；正式表达用 “netted against” 或 “offset against the right-of-use asset”。
说 “We should adjust it” 过于笼统；应给出方向：“We'd suggest reclassifying the 600,000 to reduce the right-of-use asset.”

tgt: The dryer made a loud grinding noise, and then white smoke started coming out from the bottom of the machine before I could press the stop button.

traps: Saying "the dryer is on fire" is an overreaction and will cause unnecessary panic. The correct way is to say "There’s some smoke coming from the dryer and it’s making a strange noise."

What documents do I need to prepare to file an insurance claim for this damage?
Could you walk me through the steps of the insurance claim process?
traps: 说"My fence is broken so I want to get money"太口语化且不专业，在和理赔专员沟通时应该用更正式的陈述语气"My backyard fence was damaged in the recent strong wind"。
混淆了个人损失和第三方损失，应该明确说明不仅自己的栅栏损坏，还砸坏了邻居的盆栽，避免遗漏理赔范围。
忘记提及事故发生的具体时间，理赔专员无法快速定位你的案件，应该补充"on September 3rd"来提供准确的信息。
life_meet_home_insurance_claim.ai: 你对接的保险理赔专员Emma，她的立场是向你解释房屋保险的理赔范围，告知你需要准备的相关材料和理赔的具体流程，解答你的疑问。
life_meet_home_insurance_claim.task: 向保险理赔专员咨询本次损失的理赔资格和所需的申请材料。

tgt: Hi Ms. Wang, I wanted to say thank you for always adding extra veggies to my meal. I got two free student tickets for the campus music festival this Sunday.
I know you like listening to Chinese songs, so there will be some Chinese student bands performing too. I can translate the introductions for you.
We can meet at the lawn entrance at 2:40pm before the festival starts.
traps: I want you to come to a music festival with me：直接邀约没有铺垫，会让对方觉得突兀，应该先提到之前的帮助再提出邀请。
Don’t worry, you can understand it：否定对方的顾虑，会让对方觉得不被理解，地道说法是There will be Chinese bands playing, so you won’t have trouble following along instead of直接说don’t worry。
The festival is on Sunday：直接说时间太简略，应该说明具体的下午3点，让对方更清楚。
soc_invite_campus_cafeteria_staff.ai: Ms. Wang是学校食堂工作了8年的阿姨，平时只会用简单的中文和你交流，英语不太好，你突然用英语邀请她看音乐节她会犹豫，会担心自己听不懂英语歌曲，还会不好意思拒绝。
soc_invite_campus_cafeteria_staff.task: 成功邀请Ms. Wang在9M26周日下午3点一起去学校露天草坪看校园音乐节。

tgt: That sounds like such a hassle—these machines really need more testing.
I just have a few items, so I hope it works smoothly for me.
I’ll double-check the total before I pay, just to be safe.
traps: 说 "The machine is bad" ，太负面，应该说 "This self-checkout AI has a few kinks to work out"。
说 "I will not use this machine" ，太极端，应该说 "I’ll just use the regular checkout counter if this one is acting up"。
直接说 "You are wrong" ，反驳收银员不礼貌，应该用 "I get what you mean, it’s definitely not perfect yet"
talk_tech_grocery_cashier_seoul.ai: 收银员是韩国女生，她刚处理完退款，正跟你吐槽这台新机器比人工结账慢三倍还容易出错。
talk_tech_grocery_cashier_seoul.task: 顺利完成结账，同时回应收银员的吐槽，不耽误时间。

tgt: That sounds like such a fun day out for the pups! I’d love to come but I’m tied up taking my mom to her annual check-up next Wednesday.
Thanks for inviting me, I really appreciate you thinking of me!
I hope you guys have a great time at the farm this weekend!
traps: Saying "I don’t like going to the farm" is not truthful and will make Alex feel rejected for no reason, you should explain a real schedule conflict instead.
Using formal phrases like "I regret that I cannot attend" is too stiff for a casual neighbor chat, use more relaxed daily expressions instead.
Forgetting to praise the invitation first, jumping straight to refusal will make the conversation awkward right away.
soc_decline_dog_park_playdate.ai: Alex是同社区的养狗住户，她觉得你的拉布拉多和她的柯基很合得来，想组织一次小型狗狗郊游，顺便和其他养狗的邻居聊聊天。
soc_decline_dog_park_playdate.task: 礼貌拒绝遛狗郊游的邀请，肯定对方的想法，保持邻里友好。

tgt: Hi Alex, I think there was a mix-up with the dry cleaning delivery today. I was supposed to get my wool suit set, but I got your navy trench coat instead.
I have a business dinner next week, so I really need my suit back by tomorrow evening if that’s okay.
Would you be able to swap the packages with me right now?
traps: 直接说"You took my suit" 太直接，容易让对方产生抵触情绪，地道说法应该用"I think there was a mix-up with the dry cleaning delivery" 先说明是误会再解释。
直译"我的西装不见了"说成"My suit is missing"，实际是被错拿，应该说"I got your trench coat instead of my suit" 更具体说明情况。
用复杂的句子解释干洗店的流程，其实只需要简单说明"there was a mix-up with the delivery" 就足够，不用过多解释干洗店的失误。
life_nb_dry_cleaning_delivery.ai: Alex是205室的住户，早上取快递的时候没仔细看标签，就把西装当成自己的拿走了，现在刚回家看到你的敲门声，有点尴尬，愿意配合解决问题。
life_nb_dry_cleaning_delivery.task: 跟邻居换回干洗的西装套装。

tgt: The charging gun is stuck and I can't unplug it from my car.
I tried pressing the unlock button on the charger but it didn't work.
Could you send a maintenance technician to help me?
traps: 把"充电枪"说成"charging gun"虽然没错，但在北美电动车场景里更常用"charger plug"或者"charging cable"，更自然。
用复杂的从句解释问题，比如"The thing that connects my car to the charger won't come out"，不如直接说"The charging plug is stuck"更简洁明了。
向客服说"I'm stuck here"虽然没错，但更地道的说法是"I'm having trouble unplugging the charger"，更准确描述问题。
life_car_electric_charging_stuck.ai: Alex是充电桩运营商的客服专员，他在电话里告诉你需要长按充电桩上的解锁键，或者联系现场维修人员，语气耐心。
life_car_electric_charging_stuck.task: 在客服指导下尝试解锁充电枪，或者联系现场维修人员协助。

tgt: Let’s find a low-lying area to wait out the storm, since open spaces are dangerous during lightning.
My phone is almost dead, can we use your phone to call the visitor center?
Can you tell me how far we are from the nearest covered shelter?
traps: Saying "Lightning is bad, run fast" - 表达太笼统且不准确，地道说法应该是"We need to get out of this open area right away, lightning is dangerous here"。
Saying "I am cold, give me your coat" - 语气太直接且不礼貌，地道说法应该是"I’m feeling pretty cold, do you mind if I borrow your extra layer?"
Saying "Call someone, hurry" - 太生硬，地道说法应该是"Could we please call the visitor center to let them know where we are?"
life_wx_hike_sudden_rain.ai: Alex是和你一起徒步的朋友，他会提醒你不要在开阔地带停留，并且建议你们尽快回到山下的游客中心。
life_wx_hike_sudden_rain.task: 找到安全的避雨区域，联系游客中心确认安全返程的路线，避免遭遇雷击危险。

tgt: I totally understand these books mean a lot to your kid, they’re such sweet memories.
Our library has a rule that donated books need to be in good readable condition, these 3 have heavy doodles that make them hard for other kids to use.
We can help you keep these books at the front desk for free if you want to give them to other local kids who don’t mind the drawings.
traps: This book is dirty. 错误：语气太直接冒犯，地道说法是These books have some minor damage from use.
You can’t donate these. 错误：语气过于强硬，应该用委婉的否定句式：I’m afraid we can’t accept these for our official donation drive.
I have no choice. 错误：推卸责任的表达，地道说法是This is our standard policy for all donations.
hob_volunteer_library_book_drive.ai: Alex是一位中年女士，她带着自己孩子画过的3本绘本过来捐赠，觉得这些书虽然有涂鸦但还是能看，希望能被计入捐赠总数，语气带着一点委屈和坚持。
hob_volunteer_library_book_drive.task: 向捐赠者说明图书馆的捐赠规则，解释污损图书无法被收录的原因，并提出替代方案

tgt: I'm so sorry I got blue acrylic paint on your customer's clean t-shirt. Would you let me pay for the dry cleaning fee?
Is there any way to get this paint stain out? I can help you clean it with the supplies here if that works.
I didn't mean to do this, let me compensate for the cost of the t-shirt if it can't be cleaned.

You should clean it. 语气太直接命令式，应该用委婉的提议方式
The stain is very big. 表述太负面，会让对方更反感，应该用中性的描述方式
hob_draw_laundry_paint_stain.ai: Alex是自助洗衣店的老板，他看到后会先表示歉意，然后建议你可以用店里的洗衣液和刷子尝试清理，或者帮你联系附近的专业干洗店处理。
hob_draw_laundry_paint_stain.task: 和老板沟通，协商解决T恤颜料污渍的赔偿或清理问题

tgt: I just bought $50 worth of tokens, but all the claw machines are broken and won’t grab any prizes.
Could you please refund me for the unused tokens since the machines aren’t working properly?
Is there another way I can use the remaining tokens, like swapping them for game time instead?
traps: 说"The machines are broken"，太笼统，地道说法应该是"All the claw machines here have broken claws and won’t pick up any prizes"来具体说明故障
直接说"I want my money back"，过于直接，地道说法应该是"Could I get a refund for the unused tokens?"来委婉提出诉求
说"You have to refund me"，语气过于强硬，地道说法应该个"Would it be possible to get a refund for the unused tokens?"来协商
talk_game_arcade_token_refund_denied.ai: Alex是游戏厅的值班经理，他正在核对机器的故障记录，机器确实存在技术问题，但店里的规则确实不退还开封的代币，态度公事公办但愿意提供其他解决方案。
talk_game_arcade_token_refund_denied.task: 要么获得剩余代币的全额退款，要么兑换成同等价值的其他游戏项目

tgt: Hi, could you check if there's any last-minute cancellation for today's breaking intro class?
I didn't realize you required advance booking, is there a way I can join a spot that just opened up?
Could you sign me up for the earliest available intro class next week please?
traps: 直接说“I no have reservation”，这是中式直译，地道说法应该是“I didn't make a reservation in advance”或者“I haven't booked ahead of time”
用命令式语气说“Give me a class today”，太生硬，应该用委婉请求的句式比如“Could I possibly join today's class?”
混淆词汇用“dance lesson”代替“intro class”，breaking是街舞的一种，这里应该用对应的课程名称来准确沟通
hob_dance_studio_tryout.ai: Alex是工作室前台，他态度友好，先告知你预约规则，再告诉你本周剩余的体验课都约满了，可以帮你登记下周的预约名额。
hob_dance_studio_tryout.task: 说服前台帮你安排当天的体验课名额，或者确认最快可以体验的时间并完成预约。

tgt: We observed that your working capital turnover days were reduced from 65 to 42 in the FY26F forecast.
Could you explain how this improvement in working capital efficiency affects the liquidity premium in the WACC calculation?
I’d like to verify if the overall liquidity risk of the business has changed accordingly.
traps: 说"You forgot to adjust" 带有指责意味，地道说法是"We noticed there wasn’t an adjustment to the liquidity premium alongside the working capital changes, could we talk through this?"，前者直接指出错误，后者更委婉专业。
用"liquidity premium"说成"money cost" 搭配错误，地道说法是"liquidity premium"，前者是中式口语化表达，后者是估值领域的标准术语。
直译"周转天数"说成"turn days"，地道搭配是"turnover days"，前者是中式直译错误，后者是通用的专业表述。
aud_imp_working_capital_wacc.ai: Alex是客户的运营经理，他觉得营运资本效率提升后流动性风险降低，不用调整流动性溢价，希望你通过复核。
aud_imp_working_capital_wacc.task: 和客户运营经理沟通，确认营运资本变动与流动性溢价的匹配关系。

tgt: My snowboard got stuck in a deep snow drift, can you help me pull it out?
I've been trying to get it out for 10 minutes but it won't move.
I hope the board isn't damaged from being stuck in the snow.

说"I very tired"，中式直译且表达不地道，地道说法应该是"My arms are starting to ache"或者"I'm getting tired from pulling"。
说"Help me take it out"，搭配不够自然，地道说法应该用"pull it out"更符合滑雪场景的常用表达。
hob_ski_snowboard_stuck.ai: Alex是路过的滑雪场巡逻员，他会过来帮你把单板从雪堆里取出来，顺便检查你的装备有没有损坏。
hob_ski_snowboard_stuck.task: 向巡逻员说明情况，配合他取出卡住的单板。

tgt: Do you have any outdoor tomato seeds that are organic?
How much sunlight do these outdoor tomatoes need?
Can I get a packet of 10 seeds please?
traps: 说"I need tomato seeds for outdoor"语法错误，应该用"tomato seeds for outdoor planting"
混淆"organic"和"natural"，虽然意思相近，但地道说法应该用"organic"来指代有机认证的种子
直接说"This one is not good"太负面，应该用"I’m looking for a variety that grows well outside"来表达需求
hob_plant_vancouver_farmer_market_seed.ai: Alex是种子摊主，他正在跟你介绍不同番茄品种的种植环境要求，同时帮你找户外种植的品种。
hob_plant_vancouver_farmer_market_seed.task: 买到适合户外种植的有机番茄种子，同时了解种植注意事项

tgt: Hi, could you come take a look at this mic? The reverb won’t adjust and it sounds really muffled.
Is it possible to swap this for a working one instead?
We’d really appreciate your help with this quickly, thanks!
traps: "This mic is broken" 太绝对，很多时候只是调试问题，用"won’t adjust"或"sounds off"更客观；
"I can’t use this mic" 过于直白，应该说明具体故障表现让服务员快速判断；
"Fix it right now" 语气太强硬，用"could you help"更符合服务场景的礼貌要求
hob_sing_karaoke_mic.ai: Alex是包厢的服务员，刚接到你朋友的呼叫过来查看，会先询问你遇到的具体问题，态度平和。
hob_sing_karaoke_mic.task: 让服务员帮忙调试或更换有问题的麦克风

tgt: I need to reschedule my follow-up appointment from Saturday morning to Sunday afternoon, because I have a work camping trip this weekend.
Will there be any extra charge for changing the appointment time?
Do I need to bring any test results or paperwork with me to the new appointment?
traps: 把“复诊”说成“return visit”，地道的口语说法是“follow-up appointment”，前者是中式英语直译。
把“团建”说成“group building”，虽然这个词老外也懂，但日常口语里更常用“team hangout”或者“work trip to relax”更自然。
把“提前准备”说成“prepare in advance”，日常口语里直接说“bring ahead”或者“have ready”更简洁，不需要用“in advance”这种正式词汇。
talk_plan_doctor.ai: Alex是你的家庭医生，他今天在诊所前台值班，看到你在预约本上写下改约的请求，主动过来询问你是不是需要调整预约时间。
talk_plan_doctor.task: 向Alex说明改约的原因，确认改约后的复诊时间和费用，询问需要提前准备的检查项目。
